Name: Vanilla Tweaks - Unofficial Cornucopia Edition
Author: MageCrash
Description:
[i]﻿Hey you! Do you like Vanilla Tweaks, but wish there was a similar mod in the VT-style for the popular SDV 1.6 Cornucopia and Growable Forage mods?
Well, fret no more~ Your [b]VT-style Cornucopia seeds are here[/b]!
[/i]
These features are [b]currently supported[/b]:[b] [/b]
- 'Cornucopia - More Crops' basic crop seeds.
- 'Cornucopia - More Flowers' basic flower seeds.
- 'Growable Forage and Crop Bushes' basic forage seeds.
- Basic seasonal and non-seasonal variants for seed bags.
- Basic and flowering variants for saplings.
- Only saturated variants are available.
- GMCM support.

Some features are still missing, so [b]here's the Road map: [/b]
✔️ Initial release (v1.0), with only the base non-seasonal seeds.
✔️ Basic seasons support (v1.1), with single-season or simple multi-season support.
✔️ Basic alt sprites support (v1.2).
✔️ Tree saplings (v1.3), paced on any planned Cornucopia tree changes.
🟪 Bush saplings and mushroom Planters (v1.4), requiring totally homebrewed sprites.
🟪 Total config overhaul (v2.0), with potentially with the coverage of the OG Visual Tweaks mods.
🟪 Desaturated sprites (v3.0), [i]only[/i] if there's popular enough demand.
* These are potentially subject to change, and there are [i]no planned update release dates.[/i]

This is my first time ever modding! I'm simply doing this out of passion rather than any urgent need.  [b]Patience is appreciated for updates.[/b] So cut me some slack, and expect delays when it comes to updates with this. :3 If you're rude or demand features I haven't stated above, you smell. >:[
﻿

Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/55537262]6480[/url], [b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/shimiroll/about-me]shimiroll[/url][/b] and all of you for your continued support during this modding journey.
